title: 🎨 Sharper Image Generation in Managed Agents with GPT Image 2.6!
text:
Managed Agents now create sharper, more detailed images with cleaner text using GPT Image 2.6! 🚀
We've upgraded Image Generation to deliver better-quality visuals for social media, advertisements, product images, and marketing creatives.
✨ What's New?
🖼️ Improved Image Quality
Medium & High quality now use GPT Image 2.6 for sharper details and clearer text.
Low continues using GPT Image 2.5 for faster, cost-effective drafts.
Supports multiple aspect ratios, including 1:1, 9:16, 16:9, and 21:9.
💰 Compare Image Generation Costs
New Compare costs option in Agent Studio.
Easily compare Low (~0.1×), Medium (1×), and High (~4×) relative costs.
Choose the right balance between quality and cost.
📊 Better Execution Visibility
Agent Logs now show the model, quality, and size used for each image.
Activity automatically refreshes when background executions finish.
🛠️ How to Get Started
Go to AI Agents → Agent Studio → Managed Agents.
Open your agent and enable Image Generation.
Select Low, Medium, or High quality and use Compare costs to review pricing.
Ask your agent to generate an image!
🎯 Why It Matters
Sharper visuals for ads, social media, and marketing.
Clearer text with fewer manual corrections.
Transparent costs with flexible quality options.
Automatic upgrade for existing agents, with quality preferences preserved.
Sharper Images. Better Quality. Smarter Costs. 🚀
